quote: made independently by Szekeres and Seymour in the 70's
note: Szekeres posed it in 1973 and Seymour in 1979. The Open Problem Garden source states the conjecture was 'made independently by Szekeres and Seymour in the 70s'. Tutte had earlier related work on cycle covers of cubic graphs (1948-1949), and a 1987 letter from Tutte to Fleischner indicates the problem had been discussed informally for decades before being formally posed.
